cause_quote: The reload preparation added `markPreparedModelRuntimeSnapshotsStale("prepared model runtime owner is stale before plugin drain", ...)`, retiring the existing publication before commit and making reply availability depend on a successful rollback refresh.
user_saw: After a plugin replacement failed and could not restore reply publication, conversations stopped receiving replies until an operator restarted the Gateway.
summary: The fix schedules a work-draining Gateway restart when model and reply rollback fails and preserves queued messages’ retry budget while the restart is pending.
reasoning: I checked the causing commit and its parent: the parent retired the existing reply publication at config commit, so a service-stop failure before commit left that publication in place. PR #147472 moved retirement ahead of the drain and relied on rollback to republish, while the Gateway had no restart fallback for an uncommitted rollback failure. A later change made rollback run after more failure paths, but the original dependency on successful republication was already present.
